hook: His monitor was eating 75% of his download speed

beats.say: Oscar Molnar pays for 2.5 gigabit internet but saw only 600 megabits down, after moving his USB Ethernet adapter onto his Studio Display XDR.
Plugged straight into his Mac, the adapter hit 2.3 gigabits. Behind the display, it dropped frames above about 168 thousand per second.
The cause: the adapter sends just four USB packets per burst, and the hub's go-ahead delay makes the drain slower than the input. Flow control on his router got him to about two gigabits.
